summary: Cloud view DONE & live (graph.html served static, no daemon restart needed). Prior subagent left only scaffolding (toggle button, #cloud svg, d3 import, renderCloud call) but died mid-impl leaving currentView/lastState/renderCloud UNDEFINED. Main agent finished it: added globals + truncate helper, setView() toggle wiring (persists to localStorage), and full renderCloud(d) using d3 v7 forceSimulation. Features: relevance LOD (ready/in_progress + 1-hop neighbors = foreground full-size+labels+edges; rest of reachable component = midground dimmed; everything else = faded bg dots, labels on hover); degree-0 orphans collapse into one clickable "🗄 N" archive bundle; time-decay via lastChanged||firstSeen (older = smaller radius + lower opacity + pushed outward via forceRadial), degrades gracefully to neutral when timestamps absent; reuses status colors + 3 edge styles (blocking gray solid / context teal dashed); zoom+pan+drag; positions cached in cloudPos and sim only reheats on node/link-set change (no 2s re-jiggle). Existing DAG path untouched (additive). Verified: node --check on extracted inline JS = SYNTAX OK; curl http://localhost:8787/graph confirms served file has renderCloud+setView, all refs defined. NOT screenshot-verified in a browser (avoided the browser-automation step that stalled the prior agent) — user should hard-reload + click Cloud.
